name: 请领取社会保障卡
detailed_description:
As a kind-hearted helper and time traveler, lend a hand to our adorable yet conflicted heroine! New possibilities lie ahead – how can we stop now?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Background

The game Please Claim Your Social Security Card unfolds in a realistic parallel world.

In this world, future humans have mastered time-travel technology to alter historical timelines.

A discontented future citizen activates a cross-temporal link, summoning players to help their ancestor (the heroine) reshape history's course, hoping to secure a more prosperous birthright.

Thus begins the player's adventure.

Main Content

This is a windowed workplace simulation and text-based adventure game.

Players act as consultants to the heroine, Xiao Qiao, assisting her in daily social security card distribution tasks.

Through their work, players and Xiao Qiao will strive to complete assignments, experience the diversity of human life, and make critical decisions.

Core Gameplay
The game alternates between daytime and nighttime phases:

  • Daytime: Assist Xiao Qiao in distributing social security cards. Learn workflow processes, master the card issuance system, and apply this knowledge to solve citizens' problems.

  • Nighttime: Choose recreational activities for Xiao Qiao. Gain intriguing information while boosting specific skills through these interactions.

  • As the story progresses, different choices lead to multiple endings.

Game Features

  • Vibrant art style

  • Refreshing soundtrack

  • Witty dialogues

  • Dramatic workplace scenarios

  • Heartwarming multiple endings

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Special tribute to the creators of Papers, Please and all indie developers pushing the boundaries of gameplay innovation.
